content.subtitle: Secure Shell — remote management access to this device

algorithms.description: Restrict the algorithms offered by the SSH server. Leaving a list empty keeps the secure VyOS defaults.

auth.description: Control how clients authenticate and which users may connect
auth.disablePasswordHelp: Require public-key (or other) authentication; reject passwords
auth.trustedCaHelp: OpenSSH certificate name from the PKI subsystem used to verify user certificates.
auth.requirePinHelp: FIDO2 keys must attest the user was verified (e.g. via a PIN)
auth.requireTouchHelp: FIDO2 keys must attest the user is physically present

connection.title: Connection Settings
connection.description: Listening ports, bind addresses, VRFs, and session behaviour
connection.portsHelp: TCP ports the SSH service listens on (default {port}).
connection.listenHelp: Local IP addresses to bind to. Leave empty to listen on all.
connection.invalidIp: Enter a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address
connection.vrfsHelp: VRF instances to run the service in. Use "default" for the default VRF.
connection.keepaliveHelp: Seconds between server-to-client keepalives (1–65535). Empty disables.
connection.rekeyHelp: Force renegotiation after a data volume and/or time threshold.

protection.description: Brute-force protection and host lookup behaviour
protection.disableHostValidationHelp: Skip reverse DNS (IP → hostname) lookups for connecting clients
protection.enableDynamicHelp: Track and temporarily block IPs that exceed an attack score
protection.invalidNetwork: Enter a valid IP address or network
protection.blockTimeHelp: Initial block duration; subsequent blocks grow ×1.5 (default {value}).
protection.detectTimeHelp: How long a source IP's score is remembered before reset (default {value}).
